summary: The audit checks the 135 graduate units, all in courses numbered 200 or above, DLCL 301 and DLCL 369 (letter graded where a letter grade is offered), at least 60 units of graduate ITALIAN courses, and five graduate ITALIAN courses on Italian literature and culture. Faculty expect a B+ or better and review lower grades, which the audit does not treat as failing. Checked by hand: a class of 5 or more units with each of three core Italian faculty, no independent study in the first year, the qualifying and field exams, candidacy, the University Oral, the dissertation and the language requirement.
